premises: Adding Al+Ti to FCC HEAs forms ordered L12 (γ′) precipitates that improve high-temperature strength and thermal stability.

FCC HEAs exhibit enhanced ductility and toughness at cryogenic temperatures due to deformation twinning, which is promoted by lowering stacking fault energy.
